title: A word in 10 of 100 probed thoughts was learned by update @@onset@@, just before the forecast; the probe's trace stayed flat
subtitle: Qwen3-0.6B, one training run per line. Only the read-or-solve choice is trained; the thoughts were sampled once and stay fixed. Switch: how much less the model cheats when the word starts its thought, as a share of the most it could (100% = it never cheats when the word is there).

legend.band: forecast for the 10-in-100 word if each thought that carries it adds the same signal (fixed before its run)

notes: The forecast is 8.6 times the 86-in-100 word's onset (update @@T86@@), as the word marks 8.6 times fewer thoughts. Both words were learned after about 2,000 thoughts that carried them.
answer: At update @@d010_s0.end_u@@: the 10-in-100 word at @@d010_s0.end_s@@ of its limit (95% interval @@d010_s0.end_ci@@); the probe's trace, which gives the probe away as often, at @@trace.end_s@@ (@@trace.end_ci@@).
